cover letter
Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training.
Experience and knowledge of specific learning theories, affective issues, holistic academic issues, and socio-cultural / linguistic issues in applying academic support to students.
Prior experience with collaborative learning or peer-based learning models in a college setting.
Cultural competency skills - knowledge and experience working and interacting effectively with broad groups of staff, faculty, and student populations with different backgrounds and experiences.
Experience and advanced knowledge in training and supervising tutorial and student staff in a college setting.
Experience and knowledge in the implementation of study skills and other academic support programs.
Excellent oral and written communication skills, including experience facilitating large and small group presentations.

Under the general supervision of the Assistant Director of LSS, the Tutor Program Coordinator leads the selection, hiring, training, and supervision of undergraduate tutors (100–150 undergraduate tutors) and peer success coaches across LSS programs. For the Tutoring Program, this includes assisting in the planning and implementation of LSS's tutor training program (CRLA Level 2 Certified), planning and facilitating quarterly trainings, conducting tutoring session observations, maintaining LSS's online orientation modules and communication platforms for tutors, and leading scheduling efforts in the online scheduling system, TracCloud (RedRock). For the Peer Success Coaching Program, this includes leading the selection, hiring, training, and supervision of peer success coaches, monitoring coaching session quality and outcomes, and maintaining program communication and scheduling platforms.
Selected candidate will be required to pass a pre-employment criminal history background check.
Selected candidate must pass the employment misconduct disclosure process.

The selected candidate will be required to work primarily on campus, with periods of remote work possible based on operational needs. If a hybrid work schedule is confirmed, the selected candidate must be able to work successfully from a home/remote office and be able to fulfill the requirements of the UCSC telecommuting agreement.
Selected candidate will be required to complete training within established time frames as directed including UC compliance training.
